verdict.rationale:
Ramp documents card/fund controls restricting by merchant category, specific merchants, countries, amount, and interval, blocking risky merchants/categories before spend happens and enforcing spend limits at point of sale, plus card locking. This is well-documented across product and API docs with concrete mechanisms (Funds, spend controls, card lock).

missing for 10: independent third-party/hands-on confirmation that auto-decline actually triggers at point-of-sale versus only pre-authorization blocking, and no explicit customer testimonial of a real-time decline event.
